admission: Complete reference support under every root action must have no terminal first observation; sampled absence is insufficient. Refusal aborts the phase without replacement or imputed loss.
aggregation: Exact equal-state mean D for each independent seed block, then exact mean over blocks. Cases and weights are fixed; no outcome-based replacement.
caller: Public engine.MCTS API on explicitly modeled normalized roots, not fabricated saved episodes
endpoint: L_h=max_a Q2(a)-Q2(selected physical root action); Q2 assumes optimal observation-conditioned second choice, not actual MCTS continuation.
interpretation: If interval lower>0, lower mean reference loss for H2 on this fixed corpus under declared replication assumptions; if upper<0 favors H1; otherwise inconclusive. No default change, universal optimality, calibrated win probability, CPU-time equality or encounter claim.
preservation: Original studies/records/identities unchanged. Existing adaptive H1 saved-report refusal and source admission unchanged. External action join is study-owned.
question: At 64 completed transitions, compare horizon-one/64 simulations with horizon-two/32 simulations by common exact adaptive two-round first-action loss.

resources.memory: No hard memory cap claimed; small admitted roots and bounded reference work
resources.output: Fresh owned directory; phase failure retained; no retry or seed substitution
resources.processes: one serial Python process, no workers or local native/Docker/GPU work

secondary: per-state exact losses and adverse cases
actual simulations/transitions and independent call counts
seed_design: Independent OS-drawn 64-bit labels with replacement for every phase/block/case/arm, frozen as data. No shared RNG, trajectory matching or stream-independence guarantee is asserted.
selector: existing mean then visits, retained encounter order for complete ties

uncertainty.assumption: Independently initialized seed-label experiments; no claim of iid simulator tapes or population-general scenarios
uncertainty.method: two-sided empirical Bernstein from Maurer/Pontil Theorem 4
uncertainty.numerics: Conservative rational upper bounds for log and square root, independently checked
